spec_refs: 8-class methodology: tasks.md T-GP-03/T-GP-05, design.md 4.3/5.2/3.7; group5 migration step 1 (numeric contract, 2026-11-02)

dual_head.dominance: dom_fc1(256->128)+ReLU+dom_fc2(128->5), softmax; post-process masks by activity>0.5 and renormalizes
dual_head.hw_reuse: both heads serialize over the same NPU fc engine; weight image segments are separate (activity first)

ddr3_note: planned base, disjoint from the 8-class image (0x00100000..0x001A8DE0); final map set by weight_loader
determinism: byte-identical on re-run: fixed stratified-sample seed, pure integer packing, json floats round-trip
requant_formula: y = sat_u8(round_half_even(acc_s32 * M[c] >>> shift[c]) + zp_out); M[c] = round(s_w[c] * s_in / s_out * 2^shift[c]), M[c] in [2^30, 2^31) (Q0.31)
requant_rounding_note: round-half-even is mandatory (8-class R-C lesson: truncating shifts accumulate a half-LSB bias amplified to +/-32 LSB/layer through 432-tap convolutions)
activation_dtype_note: all activations are quint8 (unsigned 8-bit); conv1 input zp_in is a POSITIVE offset, requiring the -zp_in*sum(w) accumulator correction (zp_in_correction.wsum) AND zero-padding with padding_value == zp_in, not 0
bias_note: bias_int32 rebuilt exactly from float_state.npz (BN-folded float bias, round-half-even by 1/(s_in*s_w[c])); the 8-class astype(np.int32) corruption is not repeated here

gap_contract.quantization: identity (fc1/dom_fc1 input domain == conv4 output domain)
gap_contract.note: 5-class pool4 map is 4x8=32 taps (8-class was 8x16=64 with >>6); requant shift is 5, not 6

quant_stub_input_contract.description: float z-domain feature -> quint8: x_u8 = sat_u8(RHE(x * inv_s_in >> 24) + zp_in), inv_s_in in Q8.24; the u8 saturation realizes the +/-8 z-domain clip
quant_stub_input_contract.note: calibrated on the FULL train split min/max of all_features.npy (float z-domain) saturated to +/-8 (8-class fixed-point z container Q4.12 sat16 precedent; val-set elements beyond +8 are < 1e-5, semantically free to clip). The fixed-point z-container format of the future 5-class mel pipeline should adopt the same +/-8 saturation

calibration.method: minmax + semantic saturation clip on the output heads (fc2: +/-14 sigmoid bound, dom_fc2: 24-wide softmax span anchored at the observed max; lossless for prediction semantics, monotone clip preserves argmax); interior layers plain minmax (fbgemm observer parity, 0 kept representable)
calibration.stratification: 5-bit activity label signature, proportional; all percussion-positive train rows kept
calibration.input_stats_source: full train split min/max over all_features.npy

reference_sample_check.note: logit deltas include the lossless saturation clip (input +/-6.5, fc2 +/-14, dom_fc2 24-span); the probability-level deltas below are the health signal
